title: Bionic Commando: Rearmed
provenance: Reported by DeepBlade (highball#375, 2026-10-17), Apple M2 Max, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal environment: crashes on launch or shows a black screen. The log has two loader lock waits at start and the game's Direct3D 9 going through DXVK. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Crashes on launch for the one report so far, on DXVK and on Wine's own Direct3D alike, so not a graphics fault. The log and backtrace (highball#375, 2026-10-19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26) show the game starting a second copy of itself and then raising a non-continuable exception with code 0 from its own code. It loads PhysX's loader and cooking DLLs from its folder but never PhysXCore, which comes from NVIDIA's separate PhysX System Software, so a missing PhysX runtime is the first suspect. Not verified.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash on launch, on DXVK and on Wine's own Direct3D alike (highball#375)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The game raises its own fatal error after starting a second copy of itself, and PhysXCore never loads, which points at NVIDIA's PhysX System Software missing (assumed)
knownIssues.fix: untested yet. Install NVIDIA's PhysX System Software in the environment (the PhysX component under Windows components from the next Highball version, or now NVIDIA's PhysX_9.23.1019_SystemSoftware.exe run with Run a Windows program), then start the game again
